name: Neapolitan Pizza Dough
desc: Four ingredients and a full day of fermentation, mixed by hand
steps: Add the water to a mixing bowl and dissolve the salt in it.
Add about 10 percent of the flour, mixing with your hands or a wooden spoon until it has a smooth, batter-like consistency.
Add the yeast and dissolve it. Keeping it out of direct contact with the salt is the reason for the order.
Add the rest of the flour gradually, mixing until it comes together into a shaggy dough.
Knead 10 to 15 minutes until smooth and elastic. It should pass a windowpane test.
Cover and bulk ferment at room temperature about 2 hours.
Divide into 250 g balls, place in a covered proofing box, and ferment 22 to 24 hours total.
Stretch by hand, never with a rolling pin, and bake as hot as your oven will go.
